sql: SELECT DrugName, Encounter, SUM(ValueN) AS __value__ FROM data WHERE Date BETWEEN '2026-09-01 00:00:00'::TIMESTAMP AND '2026-09-22 23:59:59'::TIMESTAMP AND Program = 'OPD Program' AND Encounter = 'Dispensing' GROUP BY DrugName, Encounter
name: query 1

sql:
WITH range_start AS (
            SELECT MIN(Date) AS min_date
            FROM 'data/mahisdev/parquet'
            WHERE Date BETWEEN '2026-06-08 00:00:00'::TIMESTAMP AND '2026-06-08 23:59:59'::TIMESTAMP
        ),
        prior_patients AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT person_id
            FROM 'data/mahisdev/parquet', range_start
            WHERE Date < range_start.min_date
        )
    
        SELECT
            CASE WHEN p.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Returning'
                 ELSE 'New' END                       AS patient_type, Program,
            COUNT(DISTINCT f.person_id)          AS metric_value
        FROM 'data/mahisdev/parquet' f
        LEFT JOIN prior_patients p ON f.person_id = p.person_id
        WHERE Date BETWEEN '2026-06-08 00:00:00'::TIMESTAMP AND '2026-06-08 23:59:59'::TIMESTAMP
        GROUP BY patient_type, Program
name: query 2

sql:
SELECT 
                            date_trunc,
                            SUM(metric_value) AS metric_value
                        FROM (
                                SELECT CAST(Date AS DATE) AS date_trunc, Program, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS metric_value FROM 'data/mahistest/parquet' WHERE Date >= '2026-08-20 00:00:00'::TIMESTAMP AND Date <= '2026-08-27 23:59:59'::TIMESTAMP GROUP BY CAST(Date AS DATE), Program ORDER BY date_trunc
                            )
                        GROUP BY date_trunc, metric_value
